items.title: Bill Berry and Buster Cooper interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: And we all said gee, he sounds like Coleman Hawkins.

ctx.x: And Benny Waters, he’s just fabulous. I mean I don’t hear that vibrato, you know like a person I mean that could play the instrument you know, 93 years old. You ain’t going to hear nothing like that, I mean he’s very swift. And he’s very commanding and — boom.
We were listening to him this morning while he was playing. And we all said gee, he sounds like Coleman Hawkins. And he would be contemporary.
